description: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of sentences across different categories within a dataset. The horizontal axis represents “Categories” with labels including “Administrative,” “Religion,” “Non-fiction,” “Fiction,” “Law,” “News,” “Science,” and “Blogs,” presented in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Sentences (K),” represents the number of sentences in thousands, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 902, and tick marks at intervals of 200.  There are eight individual bars, each corresponding to a category and colored in shades of red. The “Administrative” category has a bar of approximately 525K sentences, while “Religion” has a bar of approximately 190K sentences. “Non-fiction” is represented by a bar of approximately 35K sentences, and “Fiction” by a bar of approximately 23K sentences. The “Law” category has a bar of approximately 110K sentences, “News” has a bar of approximately 902K sentences, “Science” has a bar of approximately 2K sentences, and “Blogs” has a bar of approximately 2K sentences. The bars are not sorted in any apparent order, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
